categories.name: Saddled
categories.description: These mobs can be saddled using a Saddle. Saddling them allows the player to ride the mob.

categories.name: Shearable
categories.description: permanently changes their appearance until they respawn or regrow.

categories.name: Chested
categories.description: These mobs can have a chest placed on them. A chest can be added to a donkey, a mule, or a llama by pressing use on the animal.

categories.name: Name Tag
categories.description: These mobs obtain a special variant when given a specific name.

categories.name: Banner
categories.description: These mobs can have banners placed on them. You cannot give a banner to a mob.

categories.name: Lightning
categories.description: These mobs can be struck by lightning, which may cause them to transform into a different mob or gain special properties. I did not include all the mobs that can be struck by lightning, but only those that have a unique transformation or effect when struck. (For example, Pigs become zombified piglins, but they don't have a unique icon for that, so I didn't include them in this category.)

categories.name: Screaming
categories.description: When a goat is spawned naturally, and also through breeding normal goats, it has a 2% chance of being a screaming goat. They look identical to all other goats, but they make screaming sounds and ram more often.
